notes.subject: דרשתי … מגורותי
notes.rationale: Psalm 34 is an acrostic; verse 5 carries the letter ה, and its structure is repeated almost verbatim in verse 7 (poor man cried / heard / delivered) — a framing parallelism.

notes.subject: מגורותי
notes.rationale: 'My fears/terrors' (megurot) vs 'my troubles' — some read 'the places that terrify me', i.e. sojournings (from גור); KJV 'fears' vs 'troubles'.

translation: Ke nyakile ⟨את⟩ Yahwe, gomme o arabetše ka, gomme o ntšhitše go tšwa go ditšhogo tša ka ka moka.

tokens.gloss: gomme go tšwa go … ka moka
